from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

with open('/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key') as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

# Copy the history
seed_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5b133e40481ff1450'
new_hist = gi.histories.copy_history(seed_id)
print(f"New history ID: {new_hist['id']}")
print(f"New history name: {new_hist['name']}")

# Verify contents
contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_hist['id'], contents=True)
print(f"Number of datasets: {len(contents)}")
for ds in contents:
    print(f"  {ds['hid']}: {ds['name']} ({ds['extension']}, id={ds['id']})")
